subject: Module swap guidance for tier lift — Lighthouse Health
messages:
From: Elaine Zhou <elaine@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Packaging question — interested in lifting to Pro but unsure which modules to keep

Hi Jonas,

We're evaluating a tier lift from Standard to Pro for our clinical summarization workflows. Two things I want your help with: 1) which bundle of modules (realtime inference vs batch embedding credits vs priority routing) makes sense for our usage profile, and 2) whether there is any flexibility on the ramp discount for a 12-month commit.

Current summary: ~200k inference tokens/month, occasional bulk embedding jobs (~150k tokens/month), 3 apps hitting low-latency endpoints. We're most concerned about predictable latency and keeping cost under control as we scale usage.

Can you propose a recommended module composition and a sample price breakdown?

Thanks,
Elaine
Director of Data & AI
Lighthouse Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Zhou <elaine@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — interested in lifting to Pro but unsure which modules to keep

Hi Elaine — thanks for the details, that helps. Quick high-level recommendation below and I can follow up with a line-item worksheet. If you're available I can also walk the procurement team through the SOW and DocuSign flow.

Recommendation (short):
- Core Pro seats with Priority Routing (3 endpoints) — keeps tail latency under 200ms SLA targets for your apps.
- Add a modest monthly embedding pool (200k tokens/month) instead of per-request; cheaper and simpler for your bulk runs.
- Enable prefix caching on your clinical templates and a small KV cache for session continuity (low additional cost, high token savings).
- Keep burst capacity on standby for monthly spikes.

Estimated economics (monthly, rough):
- Pro base (3 endpoints): $6,000
- Embedding pool (200k tokens): $600
- Priority routing & burst reserves: $1,200
- Operational addon (1yr retention analytics): $400
- Total: ~$8,200/mo before discounts

If you like this approach I'll send a workbook with three scenarios (conservative, expected, growth) and a proposed ramp/discount structure. Can we set a 30-min call tomorrow?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:56:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Packaging question — price guardrails for LH ramp

Looping in pricing — quick thoughts before we reply:
- For a 12-month commit: standard manager-approved discount band is 10–15% depending on ARR pledge. For deals under $150k ARR we can go up to 18% with revenue ops approval.
- Aligning embed pool sizing to 200–250k tokens/month reduces unit cost; call that out as an assumption.
- If they want seat-based credits vs pool, recommend pool for predictable cost; seats + overage is noisy.

Jonas — if Elaine wants a 12-month ramp and can commit to a 6–9 month ramp schedule (increasing consumption expectation), we can propose 15% with a midpoint performance credit (first 2 months at 20% credit applied post-usage to the invoice) — this is a limited offer (Q4 incentive).

-Aditya
Pricing & Packaging Lead
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Zhou <elaine@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lighthousehealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — Module swap & discount proposal attached

Hi Elaine — attaching the workbook with three scenarios and a SOW addendum describing module swap rules. High level: we propose a 12-month Pro commitment with a 15% ramp discount (applies month 3–12) plus a 20% usage credit applied to the first two months if they hit agreed onboarding checkpoints (technical validation and latency smoke tests).

What this gets you: predictable unit pricing, a 200k/month embedding pool, and priority routing for your three low-latency endpoints. Module swap rules: you can swap embedding pool to extra burst credits once per quarter (subject to 14-day notice), and we allow a one-time downgrade window at month 9 with prorated credits.

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Pathways_Q4_v3.xlsx, SOW_Module_Addendum_LH.pdf

Proposed next steps:
- Procurement review of SOW and redlines (DocuSign link included in workbook).
- 30-min call to confirm acceptance of swap/downgrade terms and checkpoint criteria.

Would Thursday 10/06 10:00am PT work for a quick call?

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Procurement Team <procurement@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Zhou <elaine@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — quick clarification on downgrade window and termination notice

Thanks Jonas. Quick clarifying Qs before the call:
1) The one-time downgrade at month 9 — what exactly is refundable/creditable? Will unused embedding pool tokens roll or are they forfeited on downgrade?
2) Termination notice length for the 12-month commit? Can you confirm the default is 60 days prior to renewal and whether we can shorten to 30 days for this account?

Elaine — copying you in case you want to add anything. Procurement is OK with the discount range but needs those mechanics spelled out.

—Procurement
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@lighthousehealth.com>, Elaine Zhou <elaine@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging question — final clarifications and call booked

Thanks — answers below and I've booked the call for Thu 10/06 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

1) Downgrade mechanics: unused embedding pool tokens are prorated and converted to a one-time invoice credit (applies only if you move to a lower-tier product within the 12-month term). We do not auto-roll unused tokens; credits are applied to the final invoice period after the downgrade. Module swaps (embedding pool <-> burst credits) are allowed once per quarter and we pro-rate the remainder of the month.

2) Termination/renewal: Standard is 60 days. For Lighthouse we can offer 30 days on the first renewal only (subject to legal sign-off in the SOW addendum). We'll annotate that in the SOW.

Next steps:
- Procurement to review the workbook and SOW addendum (DocuSign link in the workbook).
- Call to confirm the two onboarding checkpoints (technical validation + latency smoke test) and capture acceptance criteria for the 20% onboarding credit.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Pricing_Pathways_Q4_v3.xlsx, SOW_Module_Addendum_LH.pdf

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
